svg.title: Synthetic liquid-cooled rack transient model comparison
svg.desc: The left plot contrasts quasi-steady and two-node predicted TCS return temperature. The right plot shows the two-node effective hardware and coolant states. Vertical dotted lines mark independent synthetic input changes.
svg.text: Synthetic liquid-cooled rack response to declared disturbances
10 kW maximum IT heat, 80% liquid capture, water cₚ = 4180 J/(kg·K); no hardware measurements or calibration
Dashed events: 2.5→10 kW IT load at 300 s; 30→34 °C supply at 720 s; 0.50→0.35 kg/s flow at 960 s.
Synthetic scenarios; verification and model-structure comparison only. Differences arise from declared thermal storage, not measured rack behavior.
